page: Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. Powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server features an Intel Xeon 8473C processor with an x86_64 architecture. It provides 88 dedicated vCPUs derived from 44 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for tile and INT8 operations.

The server is equipped with 1536.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 17.45 GB per core. It includes 410 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance block storage attachments. No GPUs are bundled with this configuration. This high resource density positions the server as a premium hardware class designed for memory-intensive workloads.

In benchmark evaluations, the M176-88bds_v3 demonstrates top-tier performance in several areas. Large-block memory bandwidth, both read and write, ranks in the top 10%, as do Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, and ray tracing metrics. Passmark database operations and static web serving throughput also achieve top-tier status. However, single-core CPU performance and Passmark memory scores fall into the average category, indicating that workloads must leverage the massive multi-core parallelism and large-block memory access patterns to maximize efficiency.

Given its high memory capacity and strong multi-threaded performance, this server is highly cost-efficient for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching, and heavy enterprise applications where resource density offsets the premium hardware class cost. It is well-suited for relational databases, large-scale data compilation, and medium-to-large LLM inference tasks, though the lack of a GPU limits its applicability for heavy deep learning training.
